To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a new FPGA architecture and circuit design that fully utilizes the unique characteristics of spintronic devices to achieve high-performance reconfigurable logic, and our results show that the new FPGA architecture and spintronic devices can outperform CMOS-based FPGAs in terms of delay and area.
we present a high-performance non-volatile spintronic FPGA architecture and design that is based on the unique characteristics of the mCell device.
we propose a novel FPGA design using spintronic devices that achieves high throughput and high area efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an all-spintronic FPGA that can achieve a higher performance and a lower power consumption.
the design of a new FPGA device based on a novel spintronic device technology.
the development of innovative design techniques for FPGA devices that can take advantage of the unique characteristics of spintronic devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our mCell FPGA design can be used to build a new generation of reconfigurable logic devices that can be used to unlock the performance benefits that spintronic device technology can provide.
the proposed FPGA architecture and design techniques can fully exploit the performance benefits of the mCell spintronic devices, and can be a viable candidate for future FPGA devices.
, our mCell FPGA is a promising candidate for future FPGA devices, and can provide a high performance alternative to the CMOS Lut-based FPGA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the feasibility of a high-performance FPGA design using mCell devices.
we have developed a novel FPGA design that is custom-made for the mCell devices.
, by leveraging the unique characteristics of spintronic devices, we have designed a high- throughput non-volatile alternative FPGA device to the conventional LUT-based CMOSTM FPGA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the unique properties of mCell spintronic devices allow for a direct mapping of logic to NAND-NOR, and in doing so we can achieve high performance, non-volatile FPGA designs.
the use of mCell-based FPGA technology can provide significant benefits to FPGA users in terms of performance and power, and can be used as a drop-in replacement for CMOS FPGA devices.

, with the right circuit and architecture design, spin-based FPGA devices can out-perform their CMOS counterparts, and that the mCell device is a promising candidate for future spintronic FPGA design.
